column1: # Class renames from Minecraft 1.20.1 (Mojang names) straight to 26.3, for classes Fabric intermediary did not
# carry across versions (so the 1.21.11 step cannot find them). One rename per line: old<TAB>new<TAB>evidence

column3: Mojang 1.21.11 mappings: ParticleResources$SpriteParticleRegistration (ParticleResources.register takes it); 26.3 ParticleResources.java declares it with the same single method ParticleProvider<T> create(SpriteSet)
1.21.2 removed DirectionProperty (it was EnumProperty<Direction>); 26.3 BlockStateProperties.FACING/HORIZONTAL_FACING are EnumProperty<Direction>, so fields and descriptors keep working
26.3 RecipeSerializer is a final record (MapCodec, StreamCodec); 1.20.1 mods implement the old JSON/buffer interface, kept as LegacyRecipeSerializer

1.21.2 rebuilt the recipe book around server-side recipe displays (RecipeBookComponent<T>, no GhostRecipe); 1.20.1 mods' recipe books become an always-hidden LegacyRecipeBookComponent so their screens keep working
